LanguageData.DDAF_PlayerDiplomacy: Diplomacy changes can involve your faction
LanguageData.DDAF_PlayerDiplomacyDesc: About the number of times per year set below, a random NPC faction makes peace with you (if hostile) or turns hostile. Goodwill moves just far enough to change the relation (peace: 0, war: -75). Follows the diplomacy change, permanent enemy, exclude Empire and ideo bloc settings above. Added by Dynamic Diplomacy Arena Fixes.
LanguageData.DDAF_BasePerYearDesc: Dynamic Diplomacy also adds this event to every storyteller, independent of the extra chance (originally 2-4 diplomacy changes and 3-5 conquests per year). 0 turns that off. Set by Dynamic Diplomacy Arena Fixes.
LanguageData.DDAF_ExtraPerYearDesc: Rolled every 6 hours. Replaces the old whole-percent chance (1% per 6 hours = 2.4 times per year), so lower values are possible. An event that finds no valid target does nothing. Set by Dynamic Diplomacy Arena Fixes.
LanguageData.DDAF_ConquestBattleStart: {0} forces are about to engage defensive forces in {1} settlement of {2}. The fighting will start soon.
LanguageData.DDAF_BaseSiegeChanceDesc: Chance that a conquest battle is fought on a map generated like the contested settlement: the defender holds its base with the garrison that map comes with (Custom Base Framework bases and Better Settlement Defense roles apply when installed), and the attacker uses the basic arena AI. 0 turns it off. Added by Dynamic Diplomacy Arena Fixes.
